Short_Sleek_Coursing_Coat.description: The Short_Sleek_Coursing_Coat is a velvety, feline-inspired integument that clings to the body like a second skin, enhancing the wearer's agility and granting them a feline grace that allows for swift and silent movements through even the densest underbrush.

Thick_Frost_Resistant_Fur.description: This thick, frost-resistant fur not only serves as a natural armor, enhancing the wearer's resilience against the biting cold of snowy realms, but also boosts their constitution, allowing them to endure harsh winter conditions with ease.

Camouflaging_Rosette_Pelt.description: The Camouflaging_Rosette_Pelt is a rare and enchanted feline hide, covered in intricate rosette patterns that blend seamlessly with the forest shadows, granting the wearer unparalleled stealth capabilities and the ability to vanish from sight in the wilds.

Dense_Mane_Armored_Neck_Hide.description: This majestic component transforms the wearer into a formidable feline warrior, with a thick, luxurious mane and an armored neck that not only enhances their natural defenses but also commands respect and fear from foes, making them a fearsome presence on the battlefield.

Water_Repellent_Sleek_Fur.description: This sleek, water-repellent fur is adapted for both feline grace and aquatic agility, enhancing the wearer's speed and nimbleness while providing an innate resistance to the forceful currents and powerful strikes that might otherwise hinder their movement.

Melanistic_Shadow_Panther_Hide.description: This Melanistic Shadow Panther Hide is a sleek, darkly enchanted pelt that clings to the body like a second skin, granting unparalleled stealth and the ability to blend seamlessly into the shadows, while also enhancing the wearer's charisma with an aura of feral grace and mystery.

Striped_Disruptive_Camouflage_Pelt.description: This pelt, a marvel of evolutionary adaptation, is covered in intricate stripes that shift and blend with the hues of the grassland, granting its bearer unparalleled stealth and accuracy in the wild.

Tough_Scarred_Alley_Cat_Hide.description: This hide, a testament to the harsh urban wilderness, is covered in thick, scarred fur that has adapted to fend off the toxins and dangers of the alleys, granting its wearer enhanced resilience and a natural armor against the elements.

Glistening_Metallic_Cyber_Coat.description: Enveloping the feline form in sleek, metallic plates, the Glistening_Metallic_Cyber_Coat melds natural grace with mechanical fortitude, enhancing the wearer's natural armor while the faint hum of reflected magic spells betrays its presence, slightly hindering stealth.

Ethereal_Smoky_Ghost_Pelt.description: This ghostly pelt, resembling that of a spectral feline, shimmers with an otherworldly translucence, granting its bearer enhanced stealth and evasion abilities, and allowing them to blend into the shadows or become nearly invisible to the naked eye.
